phases.name: triage
phases.focus: Find out exactly what to change for the quest.
phases.instructions: Ack the new quest and note it with who sent it. Look at the file tree in the workspace section, find_files and open_file what matters (run with grep for searches) until you can name the files and the change. If the judge sent the work back, start from its notes.
expect: the change in a few lines
how it will be checked (test or command)
phases.goal: the change and its check are written in notes

phases.name: change
phases.instructions: Edit only the files named in triage. Add or update a test that captures the behaviour.
phases.goal: the files are changed and a test covers it

phases.name: critique
phases.focus: Build and test; compare the output with what the quest asked.
phases.instructions: Run `cargo test --features server` and `cargo check --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --features web` (use spawn + jobs for long runs). Note every failure and every gap between the output and the quest.
phases.goal: build and test results and the gaps are in notes

phases.name: judge
phases.focus: Judge the change: pass it, or send it back to triage.
phases.instructions: If tests pass and the quest is met: post(to: <sender>, text: what changed, files, how it was checked), clear the quest's notes with done, and answer. Otherwise phase_done(met: "sent back: <what is wrong>") to return to triage.
phases.goal: the sender has the result, or the work is back in triage with the reason

phases.name: refocus
phases.focus: The context is nearly full. Summarise: the quest and its sender; the phase; files changed; test results; what is left; lessons. Reply with the summary only.
